newsitem.title: USA: Williamsburg, Va., mulls revenue bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Williamsburg, Va., mulls revenue bond issue.

text.p: The Williamsburg, Va., Industrial Development Authority has recommended that the city council approve a $3.6 million industrial revenue bond issue for improvements at Colonial Williamsburg, the Daily Press said Friday.
The request for the tax-exempt bond issue is scheduled to go before the city council on Nov 14.
Bond proceeds would be used to add bathrooms and buses and upgrade heating and air conditioning systems and parking lots at the tourist attraction.
